text:
maria: Heads up — canary deploy (kernel selector tweak) is showing a p99 jump on small-seq routes. Dashboard: https://dash/realtime/rt-p99

deploy-bot: canary deploy started by toni at 2026-03-18T12:00:00Z (job id 2026-03-18-01) :rocket:

sam: Seeing same. p50 is flat, p95 slight increase, p99 ~2x. Looks like kernel_selector changed to "auto-smallseq" and microbatch target went from 8 -> 16 for the canary.

maria: here's the canary config diff I grabbed from the deploy artifact:
```
{
  "kernel_selector": "auto-smallseq",
  "microbatch_target": 16,
  "kv_cache_prefetch": "on"
}
```

leo: profiling snapshot (samples/sec):
```
kv_cache_hits: 120/s
kv_cache_misses: 45/s  <-- miss rate up 3x
kernel_switches: 0.9/s  <-- selector oscillating
avg_seq_len: 22
```

toni: rolling back the canary now. starting revert job.

ops-bot: Rollback initiated by toni (job 2026-03-18-01-revert). ETA ~2m.

kevin: probable root cause: selector threshold math didn't include hysteresis for microbatch density. with slightly shorter sequences on this traffic, selector flips to the small-seq kernel but microbatch growth (16) increases queuing and evicts KV entries faster -> tail gets worse.

maria: yeah that aligns. proposal: add threshold hysteresis + min_time_between_switches and lower microbatch_target for small-seq canaries. eg:
```
{
  "kernel_selector": "auto-smallseq",
  "selector_hysteresis_s": 300,
  "min_batch_samples": 200,
  "microbatch_target_canary": 8
}
```

sam: Also add a KV warmup period on deploy (keep old KV mapping for 30s) and a regression check that runs a short p99 smoke test on our small-seq workload before promoting.

leo: rollback completed — p99 returned to baseline. linking post-rollback graphs: https://dash/realtime/compare?p=canary_revert

maria: :thumbsup: Good rollback. I'll open a PR with selector hysteresis + smaller canary microbatch + KV warmup and add a pre-promote p99 smoke check to the deploy pipeline.

tonI: (typo) will follow up on runbook updates for future kernel flips.

sam: postmortem checklist: add unit/regression for selector-boundary, add a perf test that simulates KV churn and microbatch sizing, and mark this as high-priority for the autotune backlog.

maria: thanks all — assigning follow-ups in the issue and pinging release owner to pause auto-promote until we have the canary smoke check.
